title: 1 Enoch 78 — The names of the sun and moon, and the lunar month

translation.sourceText: 1 Enoch Astronomical Book (Book of the Luminaries / Sefer ha-Mazzalot) — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Aramaic DSS 4Q208-4Q211, OLDEST surviving Enoch material late 3rd c. BCE, primary where preserved; Ge'ez Charles 1912 PD + Knibb 1978 fallback). No Greek witness — Akhmim Panopolitanus covers chs 1-32 only.

paragraphs.text: ወስማቲሆሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ እሉ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ኦርያረስ፡ ካልዕ፡ ቶሞስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-səmātihomu la-ḍaḥay ʾəllu qadāmāyə ʾOryāras kāləʿ Tomos

i18n.en: And the names of the sun are these: the first, Oryares; the second, Tomos.

paragraphs.commentary:
**The corrupted Ge'ez sun-names — preserved verbatim without emendation.** The Ge'ez tradition has preserved sun-names ('Oryares', 'Tomos') in unrecognizable-corrupted forms that do not correspond to known Hebrew, Aramaic, or Greek astronomical-naming-systems. Multiple speculative reconstructions have been proposed: Charles 1912 conjectured *Oryares* < *ʾōr-yāreaḥ* ('light of the moon' — sun/moon-pair context corruption) and *Tomos* < Aramaic *Tammūz* (the Mesopotamian solar-deity-name); Neugebauer 1981 proposed Greek-loanword readings (*ouranos* + *chōmos*). None of the proposed reconstructions has achieved scholarly consensus.

The WoH translation preserves the corrupted Ge'ez forms verbatim without proposing emendations, per the overlay convention `corrupted-geez-sun-moon-names-78-1-2-preserve-verbatim-no-emendation-convention`. The corrupted-names are part of the source-text-historical-witness situation; emendation would require speculation about lost-original-forms that current scholarship does not warrant.

paragraphs.text: ወወርኅሰ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ስማቲሁ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ አሰናያ፡ ወካልዕ፡ አበል፡ ወሣልስ፡ በናሴ፡ ወራብዕ፡ ኤራዔ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-warḫəsa ʾarbāʿtu səmātihu qadāmāyə ʾAsanāyā wa-kāləʿ ʾAbal wa-śāləs Banāsē wa-rābəʿ ʾĒraʾē

i18n.en: And the moon has four names: the first, Asanaya; the second, Abal; the third, Banase; the fourth, Erae.

paragraphs.commentary: **The corrupted Ge'ez moon-names — preserved verbatim without emendation.** The Ge'ez moon-names (Asanaya, Abal, Banase, Erae) are similarly preserved in unrecognizable-corrupted forms. The four-fold structure likely corresponds to the four lunar phase-quarters (new-moon, first-quarter, full-moon, last-quarter) but the specific names do not correspond to known Hebrew or Aramaic lunar-phase vocabulary. The WoH translation preserves the corrupted Ge'ez forms verbatim per the overlay convention.

paragraphs.text: እሉ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ብርሃናት፡ ዐበይት፡ ዘክብ፡ ዘክብ፡ ብርሃኖሙ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ለበበ፡ ግድፋቶሙ፡ ይከውን፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəllu kəlʾētu bərhānāt ʿabayt zakəb zakəb bərhānomu ʿabəy laba-gədəfātomu yəkawwən

i18n.en: These are the two great luminaries; their orb is equal, and their light, great according to its measure, is set in each.

paragraphs.text: ወበኪራ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ስብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ይትዌቅሕ፡ እስከ፡ የሐጽጽ፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ስብዐ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-kīrā la-ḍaḥay səbʿa məsla bərhānu la-warḫ yətwaḳḳəḥ ʾəska yaḥaḍḍəḍ məsla bərhānā la-ḍaḥay səbʿa

i18n.en: And the sun's orb is sevenfold the moon's light when measured against it, until it diminishes against the sun's light by a seventh.

paragraphs.text: በበ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ስብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ይትዐጻዕ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡ ሕገገ፡ ለዘይነውኅ፡ ብርሃና፡
paragraphs.translit: baba la-ḍaḥay səbʿa məsla bərhānu la-ḍaḥay yətʿaḍāʿ bərhānā la-warḫ ḥəgaga la-zayənawwəḫ bərhānā

i18n.en: By the sun, sevenfold against the sun's light, the moon's light is fixed — the law of her light's lengthening.

paragraphs.text: ወበቀዳሚት፡ ዕለታ፡ ይከውን፡ ምዕር፡ ስብዐ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ኮኖ፡ አሐደ፡ ለብርሃኑ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወብርሃና፡ የሐጽጽ፡ እምነ፡ ዘኮነ፡ በዘ፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ዕለታ፡ ስብዐ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ስብዐ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-qadāmit ʿəlatā yəkawwən məʿr səbʿa məkfālāt kono ʾaḥada la-bərhānu la-ḍaḥay wa-bərhānā yaḥaḍḍəḍ ʾəmənna zakona baza qadāmit ʿəlatā səbʿa məkfālāt səbʿa

i18n.en: And on her first day her light becomes a measure — by seven parts, one of the sun's light becomes hers; and her light diminishes from what was of the first day: seven parts of seven.

paragraphs.commentary: **The 7×7 = 49-unit lunar-disk-fraction grid — Aramaic-fuller-than-Ge'ez.** The verse fragmentarily preserves the seven-part-of-seven-parts (= 49-unit) lunar-disk-fraction framework that underlies the Astronomical Book's lunar tables. The Aramaic 4Q208 + 4Q209 DSS fragments preserve the full day-by-day 49-unit moonlight grid for the 14-day waxing + 14-day waning synodic cycle; the Ge'ez compresses to ~5× shorter summary statements. The witness-fullness inversion (Aramaic preserves more than Ge'ez) is one of the most-distinctive textual-features of the Astronomical Book. See overlay entry `aramaic-fuller-than-geez-lunar-tables-4q208-convention` and the foundational scholarly treatment in Drawnel 2011.

paragraphs.text: ወትገብእ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለሁስስ፡ በምዕር፡ በዕለታ፡ ስብዐ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ስብዐ፡ ለቀዳማይ፡ ብርሃና፡ ይከውን፡ ካልዕተ፡ ምሉአ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-təgabbəʾ bərhānā la-husas ba-məʿr ba-ʿəlatā səbʿa məkfālāt səbʿa la-qadāmāyə bərhānā yəkawwən kāləʿta məluʾa

i18n.en: And her light returns by a measure: in her day, by seven parts of seven, of her first light, it becomes a second full measure.

paragraphs.text: ወትከውን፡ ጊዜ፡ መካን፡ ስቱረ፡ ምዕር፡ ምክፋላት፡ ስብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ለቀዳማይ፡ ብርሃና፡ ስብዐ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-təkawwən gizē makān sətura məʿr məkfālāt səbʿa məsla kwəlu la-qadāmāyə bərhānā səbʿa

i18n.en: And there comes a time, a hidden place, a measure: seven parts together with all — for her first light, seven.

paragraphs.text: ወትገብእ፡ ብርሃና፡ በስብዐቱ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ይትገብእ፡ እምነ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለመጥፋዕት፡ በበ፡ ስብዐቱ፡ መዋዕል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-təgabbəʾ bərhānā ba-səbʿatu məkfālāt yətgabbəʾ ʾəmənna məlʿta bərhānā la-maṭfāʿt baba səbʿatu mawāʿəl

i18n.en: And her light returns by seven parts; it returns from her full light to extinction in seven days at a time.

paragraphs.text: ወበዕለታት፡ እኩያን፡ የሐጽጽ፡ ብርሃና፡ በበ፡ ዕለታ፡ እምነ፡ ዐሥር፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʿəlatāt ʾəkuyān yaḥaḍḍəḍ bərhānā baba ʿəlatā ʾəmənna ʿaśr wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt

i18n.en: And in the bad days her light diminishes day by day across the fourteen days.

paragraphs.text: ወበዕለታት፡ ሠናያት፡ ዕለታት፡ ምሉእ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʿəlatāt śannāyāt ʿəlatāt məluʾ bərhānā la-warḫ

i18n.en: And in the good days, the days of the moon's full light.

paragraphs.text: ወሶበ፡ ይትጽህፍ፡ ሎቱ፡ መንበሩ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ይትገብእ፡ ለመንበረ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ቅድመ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ስልሳ፡ ዕለታት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-soba yətṣəḥf lotu manbaru la-ḍaḥay mangala məʿrāb yətgabbəʾ la-manbara bərhānu la-ḍaḥay qədma məśrāq ba-mawāʿəla səlsā ʿəlatāt

i18n.en: And when the sun's station is written down toward the west, it returns to the station of the sun's light in the east at the appointed time of sixty days.

paragraphs.text: ወይትገብእ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡ ምዕር፡ ምልዕተ፡ በምሥራቅ፡ በዘ፡ ዕለታ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ለስብአ፡ ስብአ፡ ምዕር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətgabbəʾ bərhānā la-warḫ məʿr məlʿta ba-məśrāq baza ʿəlatā qadāmāyə la-səbʾa səbʾa məʿr

i18n.en: And the moon's light returns to a full measure in the east, on her first day, by seven by seven measures.

paragraphs.text: ወበበ፡ መዋዕል፡ ዘሥሉስ፡ ይከውን፡ ናዕታ፡ ስልሳ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ዘይትፌጸም፡ ለዐሥር፡ ምንታት፡ ለወርኅ፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይትኄፀጽ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-baba mawāʿəl zaśəlus yəkawwən nāʿtā səlsā mawāʿəla la-ḍaḥay zayətfēṣam la-ʿaśr məntat la-warḫ wa-kəlʾētu mawāʿəl yətḫēḍaṣ

i18n.en: And in the third-year reckoning her measure for the sun is sixty days, which is completed by ten parts for the moon, and two days are shortened.

paragraphs.text: ወወርኅ፡ ያመጽእ፡ ሕገገ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ለመዓልታት፡ ሠላሳ፡ ወባሕቱ፡ ይትኄፀጽ፡ ይከውን፡ መዓልታት፡ ኃያን፡ ወሐኪ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ብርሃን፡ ምሉእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-warḫ yāmaṣṣəʾ ḥəgaga mawāʿəla la-maʿāltāt śallāsā wa-bāḥtu yətḫēḍaṣ yəkawwən maʿāltāt ḫāyān wa-ḥakk wa-ʾalbo bərhān məluʾ

i18n.en: And the moon brings the law of its days for thirty days; but it falls short, and the days become hollow and lacking, with no full light.

paragraphs.text: ወሐምሳ፡ ስድስቱ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ መዋዕል፡ ለስብአ፡ መዋዕል፡ መትግባእቱ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ብርሃና፡ ዘሐሳቡ፡ ኮነ፡ ለ፪፻፷፪ ዕለታት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ḥamsā sədəstu manbaromu mawāʿəl la-səbʾa mawāʿəl matgəbāʾətu la-warḫ məlʿta bərhānā zaḥasāb kona la-262 ʿəlatāt

i18n.en: And fifty-six are their stations of days for the seven-day reckoning of the moon's restoration to her full light, whose reckoning is two hundred and sixty-two days.

paragraphs.text: ወቅያስ፡ ለሙዋዕል፡ ለስብአ፡ መንበራት፡ ይትፌጸም፡ ናኦተ፡ በመዋዕል፡ ቀዳማይ፡ መጥፋዕተ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ይትገብእ፡ ለስብአ፡ መዋዕል፡ ምሉአ፡ ብርሃና፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-qəyās la-mawāʿəl la-səbʾa manbarāt yətfēṣam nāʾota ba-mawāʿəl qadāmāyə maṭfāʿta bərhānu yətgabbəʾ la-səbʾa mawāʿəl məluʾa bərhānā

i18n.en: And the measure of the days for the seven stations is completed in due measure; in the first days her light goes to its extinction, and in seven days her light is restored to its fullness.
